data.subject: Local Ledger for Bulldog Investors
data.body:
Hi,

I'm Andrew, founder of Local Ledger. Bulldog Investors' most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in ELME, TRC, and NWFL.

On September 29, 2026, ELME received a delisting or listing-standard notice in an 8-K Item 3.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/104894/000010489426000117/elme-20260928.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

Could I send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
